quarterly_data.signal: On the post-Enhertu breast cancer phase III, CMO Rob Iannone said 'we have data showing that zanidatamab, given its unique mechanism of action, is active even in patients who've progressed on Enhertu,' coming from monotherapy data, from combination data with standard of care in the HER2-positive, ER-positive population that Jazz published, and from combinations with novel agents like the ALX agent. He said zanidatamab would, he thinks, be unique in having data demonstrating its activity versus standard of care in patients who've progressed on Enhertu, regardless of the line of therapy.
